_readme: Display labels for the enum tokens of the tech-scoring kinds and the workbook's own UI texts (English deliverables). Keys with a '_' prefix are UI texts. Tokens the engine already labels (yes/no/true/false/high/medium/low/blocker/major/minor/fact/assessment) are inherited from engine/spec/labels.en.json.
_meaning_guardrail_floor: A guardrail criterion scored below this value counts as a guardrail hit (column Guardrail hit on the sheet Scores, sheet Guardrails).
_meaning_shortlist_size: How many technologies the shortlist holds: the top entries by weighted total (column On the shortlist on the sheet Shortlist).
_meaning_score_max: Top of the score scale: 0 = not possible in the named version or plan, 10 = native, documented and proven in this segment.
